title: Gold ore bought at Ironlight Crossroads (LHS 1140, lawless) and made into circuit boards by hand at Node Beta with the pilot's own stored copper ore and energy crystal
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-16 23:58 UTC (orders.log ENT-020: block APOLLO, the 75 circuit boards and the four hand recipes, gold ore in place of silicon; T2 (e), one ship, one test beyond our space; rules F3, F12, F13). fabricate_gold_circuit_boards makes 2 boards from 3 copper ore, 3 gold ore and 1 energy crystal by hand (catalog 0.719.3), so boards need no silicon, which no field of ours holds (admirals.log ENT-003). Ironlight Crossroads asked gold ore at 138 cr, 135,224 units over its levels (book of 2026-11-16 23:30 UTC); no station of ours asks gold in depth (Synchrony 54 x 2). Per board: 207 cr of gold and half an energy crystal, against 280 cr of silicon by etching at the Central Nexus ask of 420 and 515 to 636 cr bought whole. A test: one ship with an empty hold out (F13), 3 units bought, booked as money paid once (craft inputs, requests.log ENT-172), one run of the recipe at Node Beta; requires.stored sends only a pilot whose own storage at Node Beta holds the copper and the crystal. Its RESULT line decides whether a hauler fetches gold for the faction's boards.
